thread.title: Apple and Oprah: This Is Just the Start

author: Barron's
title: Apple and Oprah: This Is Just the Start
text:
Apple and Oprah Winfrey , two of America's most enduring brands, could help one another immensely now that they've teamed up on a content partnership.
For Apple ( AAPL ), it could offer a springboard for an aggressive video-content strategy over the next 12 to 18 months, according to Daniel Ives , head of technology research at GBH Insights . He estimates Apple could ramp up content spending to $3 billion to $4 billion in 2019, when it potentially launches its own streaming service after years of internal debate and withering competition.
Disney/Image Group LA For Oprah, who recently extended her contract with Discovery ( DISCA ) through 2025 on her own cable network OWN: The Oprah Winfrey Network , the pact with Apple extends her considerable reach through a new platform. That's saying a lot for the former TV talk show queen, who has plenty of exposure on CBS ' ( CBS ) 60 Minutes , HBO , producing TV shows and movies, books, and magazines. Yet the jewel of her media empire, OWN, hasn't exactly hit it out of the park with ratings.
The multiyear deal is the splashiest so far for Apple, which previously signed showrunner Kerry Ehrin, who will work on the company's forthcoming morning drama series starring Reese Witherspoon and Jennifer Anniston . Apple is also planning a reboot of Steven Spielberg's Amazing Stories ; a psychological thriller series from director M. Night Shyamalan; a production deal with NBA Finals MVP Kevin Durant; and the true crime podcast drama series Are You Sleeping? starring Octavia Spencer and Aaron Paul .
Ideally, Oprah would appear onscreen for Apple, which didn't specify her role or financial agreement.
Apple may need her mega-star wattage. Rivals Netflix ( NFLX ) is expected to spend $10 billion on streaming content next year, and it recently signed former President Barack Obama and former First Lady Michelle Obama to produce content.
Amazon.com ( AMZN ), which could spend $6 billion next year on content, this month inked a content deal with Nicole Kidman's company, Blossom Films .
Then there is the specter -- OK, threat -- of the merged AT&T (T) and Time Warner, as well as whoever acquires 21st Century Fox (FOXA) assets, be it Comcast (CMCSA) or Disney (DIS).
Over-the-top video revenue will produce revenue of $30.6 billion in 2022, from $20.1 billion in 2017, as high-speed internet access spreads, according to PricewaterhouseCoopers .
"Now is the time for [Apple] to pave the way for a standalone subscription service to launch by late 2019 in our estimation as the content strategy could represent a key growth vehicle for further monetizing the all-important software/services, which we believe is key to Apple's growth prospects (and expanded multiple) over the coming years," analyst Ives wrote in his report today. He rates Apple stock "Highly Attractive" with a price target of $200.
Apple is trading flat at $189.06 today.
